item.title: Pantograph 1.1.4
item.description:
New

  • A new app icon.
  • Opened files are no longer listed in the Dock's recent items. Turn it back on in Settings › Viewing if you'd like them.

Fixed

  • The picture no longer jiggles while you drag the Adjust Colours sliders.
  • The "Save changes?" question always comes to the front. Before, it could appear out of sight, leaving Pantograph unable to close or quit until you found it.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3, it will offer this update by itself. Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.4.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
